claims.claim: Britain's thirty-year bond yield passed 6 percent and reached a level not seen since 1998, a 28-year high.
claims.episode_span: Britain's thirty-year bond yield reached a level not seen since 1998 and passed six percent.
claims.source_title: Global bond sell-off intensifies, as UK long-term borrowing costs pass 6%
claims.supporting_quote: The turmoil in global bond markets has intensified amid fears the US deficit is reaching unsustainable levels, helping drive UK long-term borrowing costs to a 28-year high.

claims.claim: The Guardian attributes the bond move to US deficit fears and high oil costs, with investors expecting central banks to raise rates.
claims.episode_span: The paper links the move to fears that the United States deficit is unsustainable and to the persistently high cost of oil
claims.source_title: Global bond sell-off intensifies, as UK long-term borrowing costs pass 6%
claims.supporting_quote: The threat of a renewed round of inflation from the persistently high cost of oil has spooked investors, who believe central banks will be forced to raise interest rates in the coming months to prevent price increases from becoming embedded.

claims.claim: Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine struck a Russian oil facility in the Samara region days after Donald Trump pressed Kyiv to stop hitting energy targets.
claims.episode_span: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said the army struck a Russian oil facility in the Samara region days after US President Donald Trump pressed Kyiv to stop hitting energy targets in Russia.
claims.source_title: Ukraine strikes oil facility in Russia’s Samara region despite pressure from Trump – Europe live
claims.supporting_quote: Volodymyr Zelenskyy said the Ukrainian army struck a Russian oil facility in the Samara region, days after US president Donald Trump sought to put pressure on Kyiv to stop hitting energy targets in Russia.

claims.claim: Zelenskyy also reported hits on a Black Sea target, an Oryol drone site, and a Bryansk supply depot.
claims.episode_span: Zelenskyy also said a Black Sea target was hit, along with a site in the Oryol region used to launch and store attack drones, and a supply depot in the Bryansk region.
claims.source_title: Ukraine strikes oil facility in Russia’s Samara region despite pressure from Trump – Europe live
claims.supporting_quote: A target in the Black Sea was hit, as was a site in the Oryol region used to launch and store attack drones.

claims.claim: An EU official said the Commission, France, Italy, Ireland and Britain are holding a call on releasing diesel stocks, and a spokesperson declined to comment on reports of a US diesel export threat.
claims.episode_span: An EU official said the European Commission, France, Italy, Ireland and Britain are holding a call on whether to release diesel stocks.
claims.source_title: Ukraine strikes oil facility in Russia’s Samara region despite pressure from Trump – Europe live
claims.supporting_quote: The EU Commission, France, Italy, Ireland and Britain are holding a call on the possible need to release diesel stocks, an EU official said, as reported by Reuters.

claims.claim: Residents and diplomatic sources reported overnight explosions in Addis Ababa after a drone-flight ban and a week after northern fighting began.
claims.episode_span: residents and diplomatic sources told the BBC they heard explosions overnight in Addis Ababa, including near the military headquarters in the west and in the south of the city.
claims.source_title: Explosions heard in Ethiopia's capital after drone flights banned
claims.supporting_quote: Explosions were heard overnight in Ethiopia's capital, some in the area of the military headquarters in the west and another in the south of the city, residents and diplomatic sources say.

claims.claim: A source linked to opposition fighters told Reuters they were behind what they called drone strikes.
claims.episode_span: A source linked to the opposition fighters told Reuters the fighters were behind what they called drone strikes.
claims.source_title: Explosions heard in Ethiopia's capital after drone flights banned
claims.supporting_quote: A source linked to the opposition fighters told the Reuters news agency they were behind what they said were drone strikes.

claims.claim: Christa Gail Pike, 50, was alive after two doses of pentobarbital, and Governor Bill Lee halted Tennessee's remaining execution for the year and ordered a review.
claims.episode_span: Tennessee failed to execute Christa Gail Pike on Wednesday after two doses of pentobarbital, and Governor Bill Lee halted the remaining execution for the rest of the year.
claims.source_title: Tennessee death row inmate Christa Pike survives execution attempt after two lethal doses
claims.supporting_quote: Tennessee officials were unable to put Christa Gail Pike to death Wednesday for a 1995 murder after administering two doses of a lethal drug.

claims.claim: An appeals court stayed Pike's execution about an hour before the scheduled start and the US Supreme Court later overturned the stay.
claims.episode_span: An appeals court stopped the injection an hour before the 10 a.m. schedule, and the US Supreme Court later overturned that stay.
claims.source_title: Tennessee death row inmate Christa Pike survives execution attempt after two lethal doses
claims.supporting_quote: An appeals court stopped the lethal injection just an hour before it was to start and hours later the U.S. Supreme Court overturned that stay.

claims.claim: Robin Maher said no one had previously stayed alive after receiving execution drugs, unlike seven people who survived because a vein could not be accessed.
claims.episode_span: Robin Maher of the Death Penalty Information Center called the survival singular, saying seven other people had survived failed attempts to place a vein but none had stayed alive after receiving the drugs.
claims.source_title: Tennessee death row inmate Christa Pike survives execution attempt after two lethal doses
claims.supporting_quote: Seven other people have survived medical problems due to an execution team’s failure to access a vein to administer lethal injection drugs, but no one has stayed alive after receiving the drugs used in such executions, she said.

claims.claim: President Bola Tinubu said Nigeria's accumulated economic problems cannot be erased in four years and described an age of prosperity after ending emergency treatment.
claims.episode_span: President Bola Tinubu used the sixty-sixth Independence Day address to say hardship since his reforms is real, but that problems accumulated over generations cannot be erased in four years.
claims.source_title: Tinubu: Nigeria’s Decades-Long Economic Problems Cannot Be Erased In Four Years
claims.supporting_quote: We cannot erase in four years what accumulated over generations.

claims.claim: Arise News reports Nigerian petrol rose from about 195 naira a litre in May 2023 to around 1,500 naira, and the dollar from about 460 naira to around 1,500.
claims.episode_span: petrol rose from about 195 naira a litre when he took office in May 2023 to around 1,500 naira, more than 650 percent, and that the dollar moved from about 460 naira to around 1,500.
claims.source_title: Tinubu: Nigeria’s Decades-Long Economic Problems Cannot Be Erased In Four Years
claims.supporting_quote: The product, which sold for about N195 per litre when he took office, has risen to around N1,500 per litre, representing an increase of more than 650 per cent.

claims.claim: Indonesia's House agreed to replace police chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo with Suyudi Ario Seto.
claims.episode_span: parliament agreed to replace police chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo with narcotics agency head Suyudi Ario Seto.
claims.source_title: President Prabowo replaces Indonesia police chief Listyo Sigit with narcotics agency head
claims.supporting_quote: All factions in Commission III have agreed by consensus with the process of replacing Police Chief General Listyo Sigit Prabowo with Commissioner General Suyudi (Ario) Seto in accordance with the law.

claims.claim: The European Commission suspended payments to Sierra Leone over Jos Leijdekkers, putting 18 million euros in budget support at risk.
claims.episode_span: a European Commission payment freeze over Jos Leijdekkers puts 18 million euros in budget support at risk.
claims.source_title: EU halts support to Sierra Leone over drug lord Bolle Jos
claims.supporting_quote: The European Commission has immediately suspended payments to Sierra Leone due to the fugitive Dutch drug lord Bolle Jos.

claims.claim: Benjamin Netanyahu said it is too early to say whether Iran was involved in the Dubai-Tel Aviv cockpit attack, and the alleged attacker is being investigated in Saudi Arabia.
claims.episode_span: Netanyahu said it is too early to tie Iran to a Dubai-Tel Aviv cockpit stabbing now under Saudi investigation.
claims.source_title: Too early to say if Iran involved in Dubai-Tel Aviv flight attack, Israeli PM says
claims.supporting_quote: Asked whether there was any indication as of now of Iran's involvement, he replied: "It's too early to say".

claims.claim: Bolivian police arrested Attorney General Roger Mariaca after the United States revoked his visa over alleged drug-trafficking links.
claims.episode_span: police arrested Attorney General Roger Mariaca after the United States revoked his visa over alleged drug-trafficking links.
claims.source_title: Bolivian attorney general blacklisted by U.S. is arrested over alleged drug cartel ties
claims.supporting_quote: Bolivian police arrested Attorney General Roger Mariaca on Wednesday, two days after the United States revoked his visa over alleged links to drug trafficking, a government source told AFP.

claims.claim: Britain and France gave up a reciprocal deal that allowed Britain to return some migrants who crossed the English Channel in small boats.
claims.episode_span: Britain and France gave up a deal that let Britain return some migrants who crossed the Channel in small boats.
claims.source_title: Britain and France Give Up Landmark Migrant Agreement
claims.supporting_quote: The French government soured on a reciprocal deal that allowed the British authorities to return some migrants who crossed the English Channel illegally in small boats.

claims.claim: Clive Stafford Smith told Al Jazeera executions are not the clinical process officials describe, and Morris Tidball-Binz told the UK Times that executing Pike would be torture.
claims.episode_span: Clive Stafford Smith, a human rights lawyer, told Al Jazeera he has been in the execution chamber with clients and that it is never the clinical process officials describe
claims.source_title: Christa Pike execution fails: What next when a lethal injection is botched?
claims.supporting_quote: I’ve been in the execution chamber with six of my clients and it’s never the clinical process they’d have you believe.
